skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is a research surface owned by other batches; every transferable lesson here is proposed as a commit candidate instead of written into the ledger.
A gene-replacement lesson from another gene is not a WWOX therapeutic hypothesis; forging one would convert a stated transfer limit into a lead.
No small molecule with a SMILES is proposed, so the BLOCK-1 ADMET gate has nothing to triage.
Scientists do not touch the four current files; every change is proposed as a commit candidate.
The triples are published for a blind auditor; a reader cannot audit their own locators.

entries.proposition: The cassette exceeds the nominal AAV packaging limit.
entries.snippet: a construct size of 5.1 kb ITR-to-ITR

entries.proposition: Packaging an oversized genome halved the yield relative to a same-day control within the limit.
entries.snippet: a 2-fold reduction in viral yield for our oversized construct

entries.proposition: The empty-capsid fraction was measured by electron microscopy.
entries.snippet: a full-to-empty capsid ratio of approximately 94.6:5.4

entries.proposition: The model is a heterozygote expressing about half of wild-type protein, not a null.
entries.snippet: expressed approximately half of the SynGAP protein levels of WT controls in the hippocampus

entries.proposition: Neonatal delivery reduced epileptiform activity but failed on every behavioural endpoint.
entries.snippet: did not mitigate this hyperactivity phenotype

entries.proposition: The authors attribute the neonatal failure to expression level and distribution rather than to age.
entries.snippet: more robust behavioral rescue likely requires higher doses or improved delivery strategies

entries.proposition: Raising the vector dose did not raise total protein, indicating a ceiling.
entries.snippet: suggesting a ceiling effect that limits overexpression

entries.proposition: A dose-associated surgical harm is reported only in the methods and never discussed.
entries.snippet: half of the mice that received the high-dose

entries.proposition: Seizures were not abolished at any dose or age.
entries.snippet: did not completely prevent the occurrence of GTC seizures

entries.proposition: The authors cite a precedent that restricting expression to the pathogenic cell class improved both safety and efficacy.
entries.snippet: targeting expression to inhibitory neurons improved therapeutic safety and efficacy
